The '''Koiogra system''' was located in the [[Grohl sector/Legends|Grohl sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], which linked it to the [[Molavar system/Legends|Molavar]] and [[Piroket system/Legends|Piroket systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

By [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.6}}</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Kendra Novar]], who hailed from the Koiogra [[Star system/Legends|system]], popularized the naming of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] maneuver known as the [[Koiogran turn]] after her home system.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=starfighter|type=codex|Kendra Novar}}</ref> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the Koiogra system lay in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] affiliated with [[Thrawn's confederation]] of Imperial factions.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Koiogra system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
